for failing to meet the exchange’s $1 minimum bid price requirement for 30 consecutive business days.
The company has until April 12, 2027, to regain compliance by maintaining a closing bid price of at least $1 for 10 consecutive days.
The company may qualify for an additional 180-day extension if it meets other listing standards. It may also consider a reverse stock split to address the deficiency.
The notice does not immediately affect TAOP’s Nasdaq listing.
However, failure to regain compliance could lead to delisting proceedings.
The company said it will monitor its share price and consider options to regain compliance.
On the market side, the stock traded ~1.37% higher at ~$0.39 in the after-hours session.

title: Taoping faces Nasdaq compliance deadline after $1 bid-price breach
